summary: v1.4 iteration — Real-time Tender Feed. Backend pytest 73/73 PASSED (64 baseline + 9 new v1.4 feed tests). Frontend Playwright verified every acceptance criterion: (1) GET /api/feed/tenders returns list with all required fields (id/title/description<=220/document_type/category/status/budget_currency/budget_amount/submission_deadline/delivery_country/created_by_name/created_at), only status in {open,awarded}, sorted by created_at desc; (2) limit param respected + clamped [1,100] (0 → 1, 500 → 100); (3) 401 without auth; (4) admin/buyer/vendor all receive feed; (5) UI: [data-testid='tender-feed'] rail visible on admin overview + Vendor Approvals + RFP/RFQ + All Tenders + Users + Notifications; feed loads 25 items with correct doc-type badge colors (RFP blue, RFQ yellow, TENDER black) and AWARDED green badges on 4 awarded tenders; (6) refresh button [tender-feed-refresh] triggers immediate re-fetch (verified spinner + updated timestamp); (7) collapse [tender-feed-collapse] shrinks rail to 40px vertical strip with 'Live Tender Feed' label + [tender-feed-expand] button, localStorage pmc_feed_collapsed persists '1'/'0' across reloads; (8) unauthenticated pages (/, /login, /register) do NOT render the feed; (9) mobile viewport 390px correctly hides the feed via hidden lg:block; (10) 15s auto-poll picks up newly created tender within 17s — verified by out-of-band buyer POST /api/tenders, then top item became new tender with NEW badge (blue) + border-l-primary highlight; (11) NEW badge is cleared after user clicks the feed item (setSeenTopId). Also verified the feed appears for the vendor account (vendor@example.com) with 25 items.

issues: Vertical label uses writingMode: vertical-rl + rotate-180 — legible but the 40px strip only shows a tiny pulse dot for new-tender indication; consider a subtle badge count.
Time-remaining flips to red (text-destructive) only when <24h to deadline — good; but the '13d 23h' line uses text-muted-foreground which is very light gray on white. Slightly low contrast.

action_items: None blocking. All acceptance criteria for v1.4 are met.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /feed/tenders correctly clamps limit to [1,100] via max(1, min(int(limit),100)) — good hardening.
server.py /feed/tenders excludes 'closed' tenders — matches spec (open+awarded only).

TenderFeed.jsx uses two intervals (15s poll + 30s tick for countdown re-render) — the second interval is technically unnecessary if the render already re-runs on state changes, but has negligible cost. OK.

TenderFeed.jsx setSeenTopId(newestId) fires inside Link onClick — clicking navigates away, so setState is scheduled before unmount. Works but consider capturing the ID on any feed interaction (mouseenter/scroll) so NEW clears even if user just scrolls.
TenderFeed.jsx: line 42 uses empty catch — errors are silenced. Consider logging via console.error or displaying a lightweight 'feed unavailable' banner if 3+ consecutive failures.
TenderFeed.jsx uses key={t.id + tick} to force re-render for countdown — works but re-mounts Link on every tick; a memoized time string derived from tick would be more efficient. Non-blocking.

DashboardLayout.jsx: grid template correctly switches between 280_1fr_320 and 280_1fr_40 based on feedCollapsed. Good. However, the useState initializer reads localStorage synchronously — fine for CSR but would fail during SSR (typeof window guard is present, so it's safe).
TenderFeed.jsx first-load (seenTopId=null) sets seenTopId to the current newest so NEW never fires on initial page load — correct UX (no false-positive NEW on first visit).
Feed does not respect collapsed state per role/tab — global preference. Acceptable per spec.
There is no data-testid on the outer wrapper containing the collapsed strip (only tender-feed-expand button) — sufficient for automation.

Command: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter5_results.xml`. All 73 tests pass in ~33s. vendor@example.com is reset to 'pending' status by TestAuth.test_vendor_pending_login — the UI vendor test in iteration 5 confirmed feed is visible even when vendor is pending. For NEW badge testing: out-of-band POST /api/tenders (buyer) → wait 17s → the top feed-item-<id> should have 'NEW' text + bg-primary/10 + border-l-primary classes. Click any feed item to clear NEW state (setSeenTopId sync fires before Link nav).
rca of the issue: No issues. v1.4 fully passes acceptance criteria — feed endpoint is well-hardened (limit clamp, status filter, auth gate), the UI polls silently every 15s, correctly diffs newest_id vs seen_top_id to show NEW+highlight, collapse persists via localStorage across reloads, hidden on mobile via hidden lg:block, and does not appear on unauthenticated routes since only DashboardLayout mounts it.
